review_type: Primary-agent adversarial artifact review; subagent delegation was prohibited by the active orchestration instruction.
verdict: H-SCAN-COMP1 is valid and supports DEBT_COMPONENT_SIGNAL=PRESENT_ON_CURRENT_DEV_TASK, but H-SCAN1 is not accepted and generalization is untested.
claim_under_review: Removing the debt component eliminates the fixed-A0 event benefit, while retaining debt preserves it without either proxy or duration.

decisive_evidence.S1_full: 6/6 positive across T_transition/T_high; recovered unit 317 / vlm_event_0022.
decisive_evidence.S2_duration_plus_proxy_without_debt: 0/6 positive; 4-5 VERIFY calls; no event even in every five-call T_high run.
decisive_evidence.S3_duration_plus_debt_without_proxy: 6/6 positive; recovered unit 246; confirmation occurred within the first four VERIFY calls.
decisive_evidence.S4_debt_plus_proxy_without_duration: 6/6 positive; recovered unit 317 / vlm_event_0022; confirmation occurred by the third VERIFY.
decisive_evidence.S0_fixed_coverage: 0/6 positive under the same A0 allocation.
decisive_evidence.safety_and_causality: 18/18 new physical runs, zero failures, misses, replay, future access, or candidate-observation violations; one runtime identity.

falsification_checks.alternative: Unequal admitted VERIFY count caused S2 failure.
falsification_checks.result: Contradicted: all three S2 T_high runs had five VERIFY calls and recovered no event; S3/S4 recovered their events within four and three calls respectively.
Contradicted on this task: S3 removes proxy and is positive in 6/6 runs.
Contradicted on this task: S4 removes duration and is positive in 6/6 runs.

falsification_checks.alternative: Any hierarchical midpoint/common implementation path is sufficient.
falsification_checks.result: Contradicted by S2, which shares that path but is negative in 6/6 runs.

falsification_checks.alternative: Runtime repeats are independent semantic replications.
falsification_checks.result: Rejected interpretation: all runs use one video-query and repeats measure execution stability only.

main_remaining_competing_explanation: Debt-induced ordering may align fortuitously with event locations on this development video; cross-task direction and effect size are unknown.
mechanism_detail: Debt is necessary in the tested 2-of-3 component family, but it is not sufficient as a standalone term because no debt-only arm was preregistered. S3 and S4 recover different event regions, so debt can support multiple useful orderings rather than one fixed event path.
key_uncertainty: Whether the debt-dependent advantage recurs across independent video-query tasks.
revision_trigger: Reject or weaken the debt hypothesis if the preregistered multi-task comparison lacks directionally consistent gains on at least two independent video-query tasks or if removing debt does not reduce utility there.
reporting_correction: Candidate creation is measured when a reference-positive scanned unit first reaches the top of the visible unqueried frontier, including promotion after negative VERIFY completion. Positive exposure per scan is positive scanned units divided by scan actions.
